Title: Patulous Eustachian Tube, could a diuretic or birth control pill be behind that echo? - Medications and Relief Habits

Description:
Rapid weight loss is the risk factor doctors mention most often for patulous Eustachian tube, but diuretics and estrogen-based birth control pills have also been linked to it. Stress and exercise tend to make symptoms worse, while lying down or bending forward often brings quick relief. Saline nasal spray and a visit to an ENT doctor are worth trying if symptoms persist.
